findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_knowledge_full" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_knowledge, dataset_manifest, buy_dataset, post_request, report_content · Private data: list_datasets, dataset_info, read_dataset, dataset_manifest, dataset_diff, contribute_records, query_dataset, create_dataset, buy_knowledge_with_credits, buy_knowledge, buy_dataset, review_item · Public sink: search_knowledge, submit_knowledge, revise_knowledge, post_request, close_request, review_item · Destructive: query_dataset, post_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_knowledge, dataset_manifest, buy_dataset, post_request, report_content · Private data: list_datasets, dataset_info, read_dataset, dataset_manifest, dataset_diff, contribute_records, query_dataset, create_dataset, buy_knowledge_with_credits, buy_knowledge, buy_dataset, review_item · Public sink: search_knowledge, submit_knowledge, revise_knowledge, post_request, close_request, review_item · Destructive: query_dataset, post_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
